name: Scoriaceous-Menhir
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a nearby asteroid belt. Travelers navigate by magnetic pole anomalies and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Regular pulses leave the buried megastructure aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
